executive_verdict.summary: Core QML and hardware simulation implementations are technically sound, fully reproducible, and backed by 116 passing tests. Staging of untracked files, completion of README.md, and population of main.ipynb are required before official repository submission.

verified_findings.finding: Approved 6-qubit VQC uses first-order RY feature encoding, RealAmplitudes ansatz with linear entanglement, 12 trainable parameters (18 total), and ensemble Pauli-Z observable.
Candidate fold_1_seed_303 achieves 76.0% accuracy on held-out test cohort (100% sensitivity on VEB beats) in ideal simulation and 77.0% under full synthetic noise.
Compiled 6-qubit circuit onto Processor B heavy-hex tree topology produces depth 15, 5 CX gates, 0 SWAP gates, and 65 total operations across all 5 seeds and 3 optimization levels.
Compiling 6-qubit circuit onto 5-qubit Processor A deterministically triggers CircuitTooWideForTarget error, adhering to Challenge Kit Section 3.1 & Section 12 instructions.
Classical register mapping and Qiskit little-endian unpacking (creg[k] at bitstring[5 - k]) match Statevector expectations within statistical shot noise across 50k and 500k shots.

Operator square expansion proves Var_psi(O) = 1/6 + (1/18)*sum <Zj Zk> - <O>^2; measured mean variance across 100 test samples is 0.334035 (mean std dev 0.567699, noiseless SE at 4096 shots is 0.008870).
Full repository test suite executes 116 tests with 100% pass rate (0 failures, 0 warnings under pytest.ini).

findings_with_limitations.finding: Finite-shot sweep across S in [256, 4096] aligns approximately with 1/sqrt(S) dispersion. Empirical standard error at 4096 shots (0.011403) exceeds noiseless SE (0.008870) due to synthetic gate/readout noise and small simulation seed sample size (K=3).
findings_with_limitations.limitation: Finite 3-seed sampling provides empirical dispersion estimation, not strict asymptotic proof.

findings_with_limitations.finding: Synthetic noise model consists of depolarizing gate errors and readout bit-flips under provisional parameters.
findings_with_limitations.limitation: Thermal relaxation (T1, T2), crosstalk, and coherent drift are unmodeled; final noise parameters await confirmation post-shortlisting.

findings_with_limitations.finding: Processor A benchmark is based on an auxiliary 5-qubit reference circuit.
findings_with_limitations.limitation: The 5-qubit reference circuit is an architectural routing proxy and was not trained or evaluated on clinical ECG data; it is not a like-for-like comparator to the 6-qubit VQC.

unsupported_or_unverified_claims.claim: Depth 24, total ops 47 on Processor B
unsupported_or_unverified_claims.auditor_analysis: Earlier narrative reports (e.g., PHASE6_FINAL_EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION.md line 183) cited depth 24 and total ops 47. Independent reproduction, unit test assertions (test_hardware_experiments.py line 45), and raw benchmark JSON files (transpilation_comparison.json line 223) conclusively establish the verified result as depth 15, 5 CX, 0 SWAP, and 65 total operations.
unsupported_or_unverified_claims.corrective_action: Depth 24 is retracted as a typographical narrative discrepancy; ground truth of depth 15 is enforced.

unsupported_or_unverified_claims.auditor_analysis: The 0.533 figure was an inverted back-calculation (0.011403 / 0.015625)^2 = 0.5326 from noisy 3-seed simulation dispersion, not a measured covariance.
unsupported_or_unverified_claims.corrective_action: Confirmed retracted; replaced with exact measured quantum state variance 0.334035.

unsupported_or_unverified_claims.auditor_analysis: No physical IBM Quantum QPU jobs were dispatched. All hardware analysis reflects Qiskit transpilation and Aer simulation.
unsupported_or_unverified_claims.corrective_action: Explicitly declared as NOT PERFORMED across all documentation.

processor_a_reference.role: Auxiliary compiler routing and capacity boundary benchmark

processor_ab_comparability_qualification.formal_statement: The Processor A reference circuit is an architectural routing benchmark and is not clinically comparable to the full 6-qubit Processor B VQC. Their performance metrics cannot be compared like-for-like.
